title: Objective Beacon & Initiative Mesh: company-level alignment framework
creator: Sofia Chen
description:
Goal: produce a lightweight, repeatable framework (Objective Beacon + Initiative Mesh) that maps company-level objectives to concrete initiative commitments across Eng/Product/Design and provides a capacity reservation mechanism for high-priority initiatives.

Problem statement: our current OKR roll-ups are noisy, often leave engineering squads unclear on which initiatives get seed capacity vs. discretionary work, and create frequent re-prioritization mid-cycle. That causes missed SLA targets for Dedicated customers and wasted runway for platform investments.

Scope: company-level objectives + all attached initiatives for Q1–Q2 2026. Deliverables: 1) Objective Beacon template (one-page objective with key signals and guardrails), 2) Initiative Mesh registry (canonical table linking initiatives to squads, owners, required FTE/GPU weeks, risk level), 3) Capacity reservation playbook (how to reserve capacity, policy for preemption/fallback), 4) Rollout checklist + dashboard views for Exec and Team leads.

Approach: run two rapid workshops (Leadership sync + Squad commitment), collect N=1 prioritized initiative lists from each product area, normalize commitment units (engineer-weeks and GPU-weeks), and produce a reconciled initiative mesh with primary/secondary owners and automatic fallback tiers. Pair with a dashboard widget in the Console to show initiative-to-cost traceability.

Tradeoffs/assumptions: we normalize effort into 3 buckets (small/medium/large) to keep alignment friction low; this sacrifices some granularity but is faster for cross-org negotiation. We expect some initiatives to be partially funded via discretionary buffer — playbook will define rules.

Success metrics: alignment score >= 85% (survey), <10% mid-cycle priority churn for P0 initiatives, and time-to-decision for contested capacity < 72 hours during the cycle.
acceptance_criteria: Objective Beacon template published to Confluence and linked from company OKR hub

Capacity reservation policy approved by Eng+Finance + on-call fallback defined

Post-run retrospective and alignment survey completed with alignment score measurement
